description: This file defines a class MultiTaskCompletionSource which provides a mechanism to complete a Task after a specified number of signals have been received, serving as an alternative to TaskCompletionSource for multi-signal synchronization scenarios.

classes.name: MultiTaskCompletionSource
classes.description: A class that provides a Task which completes after receiving a specified number of signals, useful for coordinating multiple asynchronous signals.

methods.name: MultiTaskCompletionSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MultiTaskCompletionSource with the number of signals required to complete the task.

methods.name: Task
methods.description: Property to access the task that completes once the required number of signals have been received.

methods.name: SetOneResult
methods.description: Method to signal the occurrence of one event; when the count reaches zero, the task is completed.
